mu_name_from: _enum.h:1636 MODEL_DRAGON_SHIELD = MODEL_SHIELD + 13, which MuMain loads from Shield14.bmd; OpenMU's 0.75 Armors.cs:49 names shield 13 the Dragon Shield.
why_this_one: Blood Castle 2's drop window reaches it, drop level 60 against its monsters' 49-69, and it was the one piece of gear in that window not built (the user, 2026-10-03: 'Build the six missing items ... then the four drops').
profile_from: The weapon profile, as every built shield uses; its default steel swapped for brass, as Shield13 records.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs:49. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateShield(number, slot, skill, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, defenseRate, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel); the group is slot + 5, 6. See Shield13.
stats.defense_rate_note: The shield's own block chance, which the fight does not roll yet. Recorded and unread.
stats.skill_note: The shield's block skill in OpenMU's table, carried for the row and nothing more.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are the wizard, knight and elf flags.

sheet_from: Data/Item/shield10.OZJ (32x64, red-copper dragon scales in black ridges) and shield102.OZJ (16x16, a red gradient), from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_note: The face is red-copper scale in black ridges: a cast, unpolished alloy, brass, as the Bronze Shield's green bronze; the colour is MU's painting. The gradient sheet is the glow below.
glow_note: MU's ItemObjectAttribute, `case MODEL_DRAGON_SHIELD` with the Serpent and Bronze Shields: BlendMesh 1, BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.004)*0.3 + 0.7 (ZzzObject.cpp:5341-5347) -- mesh 1, shield102's red gradient, drawn added and breathing.
rig_note: No .rig.json: Shield14.bmd has one action of one key (export-rig --actions=all, 2026-10-03), nothing moves.
islands_from: 16 islands for 140 triangles. They arrived as steel, the weapon profile's default (islands.py never reads sheet_materials); all brass, the face as Shield13's -- the gradient's glow part ships on its raw sheet whatever its rows say.
